answer_4.quote: We conduct an initial estimation of expected human performance on the same evaluation task by recruiting an independent group of 217 human participants.
answer_4.guideline: Each participant is randomly assigned to one of the four conditions and shown a random sequence of 20 trials from that condition... On each trial, we present an annotation from our development set along with the corresponding context of ten tangrams and ask the participant to click the tangram that was being described.
